summary.value: Itadori is paired with the grade 1 sorcerer Kento Nanami to look into killings where the victims are twisted into new shapes. The culprit is Mahito, a cursed spirit who treats human souls as clay.
While Nanami fights Mahito, Itadori befriends Junpei Yoshino, a lonely student who has fallen in with Mahito, and learns what it costs to hold on to the belief that every life is worth saving.

events.title: A murder at the cinema
events.detail: Moviegoers are found disfigured, and Nanami takes Itadori to investigate.

events.title: Nanami meets Mahito underground
events.detail: Mahito shows that he can reshape souls, his own included, and Nanami is badly hurt.

events.title: Itadori and Junpei
events.detail: The two bond over films, and Itadori is invited to dinner with Junpei's mother.

events.title: Grief becomes rage
events.detail: A loss at home pushes Junpei toward Mahito, and Itadori swears to kill him.

events.title: Itadori and Nanami fight together
events.detail: Nanami arrives in time to fight beside him and the pair drive Mahito to the edge.
